title: [DEPRECATED] Database IO — merged into notion-database v0.6
description: Single dropdown that combines CSV + JSON import/export for notion-database. DatabaseIOActions ships one trigger with six items: Export CSV, Export JSON, Import CSV…, Import JSON…, Download CSV template, Download JSON template. Templates generated from live db.properties — headers (CSV) or wire-format schema (JSON) reflect the current column set, with placeholder cells hinting at the expected format per property type. Pure / props-driven. Replaces standalone database-csv + database-json (both removed 2026-05-22 in CK-1E).

peers.reason: Reuses Database / Property / PropertyValue / PropertyType / SelectOption / Page / DatabaseViewConfig domain types from notion-database (which re-exports them from notion-shell).
